Mini Cinnamon Sugar Donuts! Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the milk, yeast, and sugar. Add the egg, flour, salt, and softened butter all at once, then mix and coil fold the dough several times. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. Coil fold again, cover, and let rise for 2 hours or until doubled in size. 2. Place your dough onto a work surface and shape it into a long log. Using a knife, cut it into 24 equal pieces. 3. Roll each piece into a ball and place it onto a small square of parchment paper. Gently flatten each one, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes. Uncover and let rest for another 5 minutes before frying. 4. Make sure the oil is hot before frying. Carefully place the donuts into the hot oil, gently remove the parchment paper, and fry until golden on both sides. 5. Mix the sugar and cinnamon together. While the donuts are still warm, coat both sides in the cinnamon sugar. #donuts #donut #bread #breadtok #homemade

30-Minute Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes 🥩🥔🧄 If you need a quick and easy dinner idea, you have to try these garlic butter steak bites and potatoes! The potatoes are perfectly seasoned and crispy, and the steak is juicy, tender, and tossed in the most delicious garlic butter. And the best part? You can have dinner on the table in about 30 minutes! 🤤 RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  Potatoes: * 4 russet potatoes, diced * 2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp each: salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika & Italian seasoning * ½ tsp black pepper Steak: * 1½ lbs sirloin tip steak, cubed * 1 tsp olive oil * 1–2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1 tbsp oil for cooking * 2 tbsp butter * 3 cloves garlic, minced * Fresh parsley Instructions 👩🏽‍🍳 1. Wash, peel, and dice your potatoes. Toss with olive oil and seasonings. Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Y’all know I don’t measure. I just season until my ancestors tell me to stop! 😂 2. Air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy. You can also bake at 425°F for 25–30 minutes or pan-fry! 3. While those cook, cut your steak into bite-sized pieces and toss with a little olive oil and steak seasoning. I used Montreal, but use your favorite! 4. Get your skillet nice and hot! Add a little oil and sear steak for about 2 minutes per side until browned. Cast iron works best, but any skillet will do! 5. Reduce heat, scoot steak to the edges, and add butter and garlic. Cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then toss everything in that garlic butter. 6. Turn off the heat, add your crispy potatoes, gently mix, and top with fresh parsley! Serve with cheesy rice, mac and cheese, asparagus, or whatever your heart desires! ❤️ Save this for your next easy weeknight dinner! 🔖 #GarlicButterSteakBites #SteakAndPotatoes #30MinuteMeals #EasyDinnerIdeas #WeeknightDinners

What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

Cheesy Garlic Potato Bread 🥔🧀 Prep Time: 1 hr 40 mins | Cook Time: 25 mins | Servings: 6-8 INGREDIENTS Soft Milk Dough 3 cups bread flour, plus extra for dusting 1 cup whole or 2% milk, warmed to 105°F-110°F 2 tsp instant yeast (1 standard packet) 1 tbsp granulated sugar (or honey) 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt 2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra for greasing Creamy Gold Potato and Mozzarella Filling 1 lb Yukon Gold potatoes (about 2 medium-large), peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks 1 1/2 tbsp unsalted butter 1 1/2 tbsp mayonnaise (or sour cream/cream cheese) 1-2 tbsp milk, as needed 1/2 tsp kosher salt (plus salt for boiling water) 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper 1/4 tsp garlic powder 2 to 2 1/2 cups low-moisture mozzarella cheese, shredded Pan-Frying and Garlic Butter Finish 2-3 tbsp neutral oil or unsalted butter, divided 3 tbsp unsalted butter, melted 2-3 cloves garlic, finely grated or minced 2 tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped 1/4 tsp kosher salt INSTRUCTIONS 1. Whisk warm milk, sugar, and instant yeast in a large bowl and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy. Add bread flour, 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt, and 2 tbsp olive oil, stirring until a shaggy dough forms. 2. Knead on a lightly floured surface for 6-8 minutes by hand (or 5-6 minutes in a stand mixer) until smooth and elastic. Place in a lightly oiled bowl, cover tightly, and let rise in a warm spot for 60-90 minutes until doubled. 3. Boil Yukon Gold potato chunks in salted water for 12-15 minutes until fork-tender. Drain thoroughly and return to the hot pot for 1 minute over low heat to evaporate excess moisture. 4. Mash potatoes smooth with 1 1/2 tbsp butter, mayonnaise, 1-2 tbsp milk, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Cool completely to room temperature. 5. Punch down risen dough and divide into 8 equal balls. Roll each ball into a 5-inch circle, keeping the center slightly thicker than the edges. 6. Scoop 2 tbsp cooled mashed potatoes onto the center of a circle, flatten slightly, and top with a generous handful of shredded mozzarella, leaving a clean 1/2-inch border. 7. Gather dough edges over the filling, pinch the seam tightly shut, and place seam-side down on a lightly floured counter. Gently flatten with your palm and work into a 1/2-inch-thick disc. Repeat with remaining dough. 8. Heat 1 tbsp oil or butter in a large skillet over medium-low to medium heat. Cook 1-2 flatbreads for 3-4 minutes until golden-brown and blistered on the bottom. 9. Flip, press gently with a spatula, and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden on the second side. 10. Stir together 3 tbsp melted butter, grated garlic, chopped parsley, and 1/4 tsp salt. Mac & Cheese Recipe! This is the winning recipe from our blind tasting! I’ve included the recipe below, but highly recommend checking out my Substack for the detailed walkthrough and my tips for making the best mac & cheese. Link in bio ❤️ For the most consistent results, I recommend using a kitchen scale. The below makes one 9x13 dish ~10-12 servings.  - 1 lb (16 oz / 454 g) dry cavatappi - 288 g sharp cheddar (~2½ cups) - 206 g whole-milk low-moisture mozzarella (~1¾ cups) - 164 g Gruyère (~1½ cups) - 164 g Colby Jack (~1½ cups) - Additional cheese for topping as needed for full coverage - 5 tbsp (71 g) unsalted butter, plus more for greasing the baking dish - 2½ tsp garlic powder - 2 tsp smoked paprika - 3 tbsp (24 g) all-purpose flour - 710 ml evaporated milk (two 12-fl-oz cans) - 310 ml heavy cream (~1⅓ cups) - 1¼ tsp kosher salt (Diamond Crystal) - 1½ tsp finely ground black pepper - Fresh parsley  Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F and grease a 9×13-inch baking dish with butter. 2. Shred and combine the cheeses. Set aside 493 g (~4½ cups) for the sauce and the remaining 329 g (~3 cups) for layering and topping. 3. Boil pasta in salted water until 1–2 minutes shy of al dente. Drain and set aside. 4. Melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic powder and smoked paprika, stirring for 20–30 seconds until fragrant. Whisk in flour and cook for 2–4 minutes until lightly toasted. 5. Gradually whisk in evaporated milk, a little at a time, until smooth. Stir in heavy cream, salt, and pepper. 6. Reduce heat to low and gradually add the reserved 493 g of cheese, one handful at a time, stirring until melted. Avoid overheating to prevent a grainy texture. Taste and adjust seasonings. The sauce should be thick but pourable.  7. Fold pasta into the cheese sauce. Add half to the baking dish, sprinkle with ~⅓ of the remaining shredded cheese, then add the rest of the pasta. Top with the remaining cheese, adding extra as needed for full coverage. 8. Bake for 20–25 minutes until the cheese is melted and the edges are bubbling. Every oven is different so check around minute 18 to avoid overbaking. Broil on low for 1–3 minutes until golden brown. WATCH CAREFULLY! 9. Let rest for ~10-15 minutes, then garnish with fresh parsley. A few extra tips below (details on substack): 1. Don’t overbake. Your pasta and sauce are already cooked. Every oven is different, so start checking around minute 18. You’re looking for fully melted cheese and bubbling edges. Overbaking can make the sauce grainy or curdled. 2. Keep the heat low. Add your cheese gradually over low heat, stirring until smooth and melted. Don’t let it get too hot or it could create a grainy texture. 3. Watch your sauce consistency. The finished cheese sauce should be smooth, creamy, and pourable. If the finished sauce is too thin, gradually add a little more cheese. Too thick? Add a splash of evaporated milk. 4. Measure and shred your cheese. I highly recommend using a kitchen scale for accurate measurements (the cups listed are approximate). If helpful, here’s the breakdown in ounces and approximate 8 oz blocks: 10.2 oz sharp cheddar (~1¼ blocks), 7.3 oz low-moisture mozzarella (a little less than 1 block), 5.8 oz Gruyère (~¾ block), and 5.8 oz Colby Jack (~¾ block). Make sure to use low-moisture mozzarella, not fresh mozzarella! Fresh mozzarella has a much higher water content, which can make your mac & cheese watery. 5. Don’t overcook your pasta. Cook until al dente since it will continue absorbing moisture in the oven. #macandcheese #thanksgiving #Recipe #chef #cooking

Thick, beautifully browned pieces of beef simmer low and slow in a rich, savory garlic butter gravy with sweet caramelized onions. Baked Sardines in White Wine Tomato Sauce with Garlicky Baguette Crostini.  @wildplanetfoods Sardines are sustainably caught with a mild flavor and they are a great way to eat lower on the food chain. Sardines are considered a Superfood as they are low in calories and high in nutrients such as Calcium, Vitamin D, B12, Iron, Omega-3 fatty acids and more!  Ingredients:  2 cans @wildplanetfoods Wild Sardines (lightly smoked) in extra virgin olive oil  8 oz cherry/grape tomatoes  1/4 red onion, thinly sliced  1/4 cup Kalamata olives  1 tbs capers  10 garlic confit cloves  3 tbs garlic confit oil  1/4 cup white wine  1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  1/2 lemon, juiced+ zested  1 tbs parsley, for serving  For the garlic confit: (note: you won’t use it all for one recipe) 2 garlic heads  1/2 cup olive oil  1/2 tsp salt  2 thyme sprigs  1 rosemary spring  A scrunch of black pepper  Baguette crostini 1 Demi Baguette  2 tbs olive oil  1 tsp salt Black pepper  1 garlic clove, for rubbing  Method:  1. Preheat oven to 350 F; 2. Peel and add garlic cloves to a small pot, along with olive oil, salt, pepper, thyme and rosemary; roast for about an hour and a half; (you can prepare this ahead of time and cook garlic confit along another meal on the oven); 3. Preheat oven to 450; 4. Add tomatoes, red onion, Kalamata olives, capers, garlic confit, garlic oil, white wine, Italian season, lemon zest + juice to a skillet/pan and roast for about 20 minutes; then add sardines on top on broil for about 5 minutes;  5. Season baguette crostini with olive oil, salt and pepper and toast on a pan or a griddle; then rub with a garlic clove;  6. Serve atop crostini or simply dip in and enjoy, the sauce is so full of flavor!  #sardines #wildplanetpartner #seafoodbake #seafoodlovers #garlicconfit #recipeshare

Creamy Tuscan Chicken Rigatoni 🍝 Recipe ⬇️ Juicy, perfectly seasoned chicken over rigatoni tossed in a creamy garlic Parmesan sauce loaded with sun-dried tomatoes, spinach, and fresh veggies. And yes, we're pouring even more sauce over the chicken! INGREDIENTS CHICKEN + 1 lb chicken breasts + 1 tsp smoked paprika + 1 tbsp garlic powder + 1 tsp Italian seasoning + 1 tsp black pepper + ½ tsp salt + 1 tbsp avocado oil PASTA + 10 oz rigatoni + ½ cup reserved pasta water, plus more as needed CREAMY TUSCAN SAUCE + 2 cups heavy cream + 1½ tbsp butter + 2 tbsp cooking oil + 1 shallot, diced + 10 garlic cloves, minced + ½ red bell pepper, diced + 12 cherry tomatoes, halved + ⅓ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped + 1 cup freshly grated Parmesan + 1 cup baby spinach + ¾ tsp chicken bouillon powder SAUCE SEASONINGS + ½ tsp smoked paprika + ½ tsp garlic powder + ½ tsp black pepper + ½ tsp Italian seasoning + ¼ tsp red pepper flakes + Salt to taste FINISHING + 1–2 tsp fresh lemon juice (optional) + Fresh parsley + Extra Parmesan DIRECTIONS + STEP 1: SEASON & SEAR Butterfly chicken into cutlets and coat with seasonings. Sear in avocado oil over medium-high heat for 3–5 minutes per side until golden and 165°F internally. Remove and rest. + STEP 2: COOK THE PASTA Cook rigatoni in salted water until al dente. Reserve pasta water before draining. + STEP 3: SAUTÉ THE VEGGIES In the same skillet, add butter, oil, shallot, and bell pepper. Cook 3–4 minutes. Add garlic, cherry tomatoes, and sun-dried tomatoes. Cook another 2–3 minutes. + STEP 4: MAKE THE SAUCE Reduce heat to medium-low. Add heavy cream, ½ cup pasta water, bouillon, and all sauce seasonings. Simmer 3–4 minutes. Reduce heat to low and gradually stir in Parmesan until smooth. + STEP 5: COMBINE Reserve ¾ cup sauce for drizzling. Add spinach to the skillet and cook until wilted. Toss in rigatoni, adding pasta water as needed. Finish with lemon juice if desired. + STEP 6: SERVE Slice chicken and arrange over the pasta. Drizzle with reserved creamy sauce and finish with Parmesan and parsley. Enjoy! #tuscanchicken #chickenpasta #rigatoni #pastarecipe #comfortfood

One Pan Honey Garlic Chicken 🍯🧄 Prep Time: 10 mins | Cook Time: 15 mins | Servings: 4 INGREDIENTS Seasoned Chicken 1.5-2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces (NOTE: the video features chicken breasts, but this recipe will be the best with thighs) 2 tbsp cornstarch 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp smoked paprika 1/2 tsp freshly cracked black pepper 1/2 tsp kosher salt (to taste) 1-2 tbsp neutral oil (for pan-searing) Honey Garlic Ginger Glaze 1/3 cup honey 1/4 cup low-sodium soy sauce 4-5 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated 2 tbsp water or chicken broth (optional) For Serving and Garnish Cooked white rice Toasted sesame seeds Sliced scallions (green onions) INSTRUCTIONS 1. Pat chicken thighs dry with paper towels and toss in a bowl with garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and salt. Add cornstarch and toss again until evenly coated in a thin, powdery layer. 2. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering. Add chicken in a single layer (avoid overcrowding) and cook for 4-5 minutes per side (or 6-7 minutes total if cut into bite-sized pieces) until golden-brown on the outside and just underdone inside (about 155°F-160°F). 3. Drop heat to medium-low. Push chicken to the edges of the skillet and add minced garlic and grated ginger to the center, stirring for 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in honey and soy sauce (plus water or broth if using). 4. Toss chicken continuously in the bubbling sauce for 2-3 minutes until the residual cornstarch thickens the sauce into a glossy glaze and chicken reaches at least 175°F internal. 5. Serve immediately over warm white rice, spooning extra pan glaze over the top. Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and sliced scallions. #recipe #cooking #asmr #foodtok

Smothered Green Beans 🫛🥓🥔 FULL RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  A delicious side dish that I have to have on the table for holiday meals! Hope y’all enjoy this one 🙌🏿🔥  Ingredients:  Green Beans- ~ 44oz Petite Golden Potatoes - 24oz bag Onion- 1 Red Bell Pepper- 1 Garlic- 4 cloves Bacon- 12oz Beef Smoked Sausage- 12oz Flour- 3 tbsp Chicken Stock (low sodium)- 7 cups Chicken Bouillon- 1 tbsp Salt- 1 tbsp White Pepper- 1 tbsp Onion Powder- 1 tbsp Garlic Powder- 1 tbsp Paprika-  2 tbsp Complete Seasoning or All Purpose Seasoning (salt free)- 2 tbsp Worcestershire Sauce- 1 tbsp Hot Sauce- 2 tbsp Cornstarch (for slurry)- 1 tbsp Water (for slurry) - 1 tbsp   Method:  Prep your ingredients before you start cooking to make the process smoother includes: chopping onions, garlic and peppers, chopping up the bacon and sausage, snipping and washing green beans, and cutting the golden potatoes in half.    Cook the bacon in a big pot on medium heat while constantly stirring allowing it to cook in its own fat. Once its crispy, remove from the pan and go in with the sliced sausage cooking until crispy, then remove.    Into the same pot add the onions and peppers and cook until translucent then add in the chopped garlic and cook until fragrant. Once its cooked start a roux by adding flour and fully combining.    Slowly pour and stir chicken stock into the roux. Once fully incorporated season the gravy with the seasonings listed above along with hot sauce and worcestershire sauce.    Add in the green beans and fully combine, then cover with a lid and cook on medium for about 45 minutes. Take the lid off and add in the potatoes. Cover with a lid again for about 30 minutes or until the potatoes are fork tender.    Add the cornstarch slurry in and allow the gravy to thicken up and you should be set! Be sure to add a little salt at the end (to taste). Then add to a serving dish or directly to your plate and dig in. Enjoy!  #homecooking #holidaydishes #foodtok #fyp #easyrecipe

✨ Cheesy Meat-Stuffed Breakfast Biscuits ✨ A delicious, flaky, and cheese-packed comfort food recipe featuring golden-brown biscuits stuffed with savory ground meat and melted cheese. 🍴 Ingredients: - 1 package refrigerated biscuit dough or homemade biscuit dough - 1 lb ground beef or sausage, cooked and seasoned - 1.5 cups shredded cheddar cheese - 2 tbsp melted butter - 1 tsp garlic powder - Fresh parsley, finely chopped for garnish - Salt and freshly cracked black pepper to taste 👩🏽‍🍳 Instructions: 1. Preheat your oven to 350°F (175°C) and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. 2. Cook the ground meat in a skillet with salt, pepper, and garlic powder until fully browned, then drain excess fat. 3. Separate the biscuit dough, flatten each piece slightly, and place a spoonful of cooked meat and a generous amount of shredded cheese in the center. 4. Fold the dough securely around the filling to form stuffed biscuit balls or rounds, pinching the edges to seal. 5. Arrange the stuffed biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. 6. Brush the tops with melted butter and sprinkle a little extra cheese or parsley on top. 7. Bake in the preheated oven for 15 to 18 minutes until the biscuits are golden brown and cooked through. 8. Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm. 📝 Notes: These flaky, cheese-stuffed biscuits make the ultimate grab-and-go breakfast, packed with rich flavor in every single bite. #BreakfastBiscuits #StuffedBiscuits #CheeseLovers #ComfortFood #SavoryBaking

Easy High Protein Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese🍯🍗🧀 59g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros Per Serve, Makes 4 Servings) 587 Calories 67.5gC | 9gF | 59gP Like recipes like this? Check out my cookbooks! LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! Store in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 3 to 4 days, or freeze individual portions for longer storage. #macandcheese #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes #chickenmacandcheese

Creamy Chicken Tostones 😍 This recipe is a 10/10, and I’m already thinking about making it again next week. 😋 Ingredients:  * 2 chicken breasts, cut into bite-size pieces * ½ teaspoon each salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and oregano * Oil, for cooking the chicken and frying the plantains * 2 green plantains, peeled and cut into chunks * ⅓ red bell pepper, sliced * ⅓ green bell pepper, sliced * ⅓ white onion, sliced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 tablespoon butter * 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, plus more for topping * 1 tablespoon tomato paste * 1/2  chicken bouillon * 1½ cups heavy cream, or adjust to your preferred amount of sauce * ⅓ cup Parmesan cheese (add more if you want to) Instructions: 1. Season the chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and oregano. 2. Heat a little oil in a pan over high heat. Add the chicken and sear until browned and cooked through, about 5–7 minutes, depending on the size of the pieces. Remove from the pan and set aside. 3. Heat oil in a separate pan over medium-low heat. Fry the plantain chunks until tender but not too browned. Remove and flatten each piece with a tostonera or the bottom of a cup. 4. Raise the heat and fry the flattened plantains until crispy and golden. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate and sprinkle with salt right away. 5. In a pan, heat a little oil and melt the butter. Add the peppers and onion and cook for about a minute. Add the garlic and cilantro and cook for another 1–2 minutes. 6. Stir in the tomato paste and chicken bouillon. Add the heavy cream and Parmesan, then stir until the sauce is smooth and creamy. 7. Add the chicken back to the pan and toss to coat. Taste and adjust the salt as needed. Finish with cilantro. 8. Spoon the creamy chicken over the tostones, or serve it on the side. Italian Meatball Soup 🥣🇮🇹 This soup is quick to make, and full of homestyle Italian flavor. Perfect for any night of the week. Especially as the weather starts to get cold and you want something warm and comforting. This meatball soup will be on repeat all winter long!  Ingredients:  1 lb (450 g) ground beef 50 g grated Parmigiano Reggiano 50 g breadcrumbs 1 egg Salt and black pepper, to taste 1.5 cups orzo 1 carrot, diced 1 celery stalk, diced 1 onion, diced 2 potatoes, cubed A handful of spinach Extra-virgin olive oil In Directions:  1. In a large pot, drizzle olive oil and sauté the carrot, celery, onion, and potatoes until softened. 2. Add 8-9 cups of water and bring to a boil. Simmer for 10 minutes. 3. Meanwhile, mix the beef, egg, breadcrumbs, Parmigiano, salt, and pepper. Roll into tiny meatballs. 4. Drop the meatballs and orzo into the simmering broth. Cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. 5.
